v7：修复登录面板在真机报 TypeError: java.lang.reflect.Array.newInstance 不是函数（改用 BufferedReader 文本流读法，规则层同步去掉 byte[] 创建）；测速判据放宽为「有实质响应即通」；恢复「检查登录状态」并升级为线路自检按钮（显示版本/字节数/是否盾页/影片链接数）。线路仍从发布页动态获取、测速不自动切换。
2026.11.13 v8：新增子内容规则(subContent)，从站内弹幕接口取弹幕供内置播放器加载；
播放/线路/目录/正文解密与 v7 完全一致，弹幕取不到时静默放弃、不影响播放。

loginUrl:
<js>
function login(){}
var OM_DEF=['https://www.omofuns.com','https://cn.233dm.com','https://cn.211dm.com','https://cn.agekkkk.com'];
var OM_PUB='https://fb.omoo.tv/';
var OM_UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13; SM-G991B) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/131.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36';
function OM_g(v){var x=String(v===undefined||v===null?'':v);return (x==='null'||x==='undefined'||x==='JsNull'||x==='[object Object]')?'':x;}
function OM_pub(sv){var v=OM_g(sv.get('om_pub')).replace(/\/+$/,'');return v.indexOf('http')===0?v:OM_PUB;}
function OM_toast(jv,m){try{jv.toast(m);return;}catch(e){}try{jv.longToast(m);}catch(e2){}}

// 纯 JS base64 解码（Latin-1，线路 URL 均为 ASCII）
function OM_b64d(s){
  var t='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/',o='',buf=0,bits=0,i,v;
  for(i=0;i<s.length;i++){
    var ch=s.charAt(i);if(ch==='='||ch==='\n'||ch==='\r'||ch===' ')continue;
    v=t.indexOf(ch);if(v<0)continue;
    buf=((buf<<6)|v)&0xFFFFFF;bits+=6;
    if(bits>=8){bits-=8;o+=String.fromCharCode((buf>>bits)&255);}
  }
  return o;
}

// 原生 HttpURLConnection：发布页 / 线路探活共用，绝不调用 java.ajax（真机会 ClassCastException）
function OM_GET(url){
  var out={h:'',ms:0,ok:false,err:''},t0=Date.now();
  try{
    var c=new Packages.java.net.URL(String(url)).openConnection();
    c.setRequestMethod('GET');c.setConnectTimeout(6000);c.setReadTimeout(10000);
    c.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
    c.setRequestProperty('User-Agent',OM_UA);
    c.setRequestProperty('Accept','text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8');
    c.setRequestProperty('Accept-Language','zh-CN,zh;q=0.9');
    c.setRequestProperty('Accept-Encoding','gzip, deflate');
    out.h=OM_TXT(c);
    // 判据放宽：只要拿到实质响应就算「线路通」。安全验证页也是通的（过盾由规则层负责）。
    out.ok=out.h.length>=1000;
  }catch(e){out.err=String(e);}
  out.ms=Date.now()-t0;return out;
}
// 文本流读法：不创建 Java byte[]，避开真机上会崩的反射建数组 API
function OM_TXT(c){
  var is=c.getInputStream();
  try{
    var enc=c.getHeaderField('Content-Encoding');
    if(enc&&String(enc).toLowerCase().indexOf('gzip')>=0)
      is=new Packages.java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream(is);
  }catch(e){}
  var br=new Packages.java.io.BufferedReader(new Packages.java.io.InputStreamReader(is,'UTF-8'));
  var sb=new Packages.java.lang.StringBuilder(),ln;
  while((ln=br.readLine())!==null)sb.append(ln).append('\n');
  try{br.close();}catch(e2){}
  return String(sb.toString());
}

// 从发布页混淆脚本里执行出 encodedLinks（脚本字符串已打散，纯正则取不到，必须 eval）
function OM_fetchLines(jv,pub){
  var r=OM_GET(pub);
  if(!r.h)return{err:'\u65e0\u6cd5\u8bfb\u53d6\u53d1\u5e03\u9875\uff1a'+(r.err||'\u7a7a\u54cd\u5e94')};
  var re=/<script[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g,m,code='';
  while((m=re.exec(r.h))!==null){if(m[1].indexOf('encodedLinks')>=0)code=m[1];}
  if(!code)return{err:'\u53d1\u5e03\u9875\u672a\u627e\u5230\u7ebf\u8def\u6570\u7ec4\uff08\u7ed3\u6784\u53ef\u80fd\u5df2\u53d8\uff09'};
  var encodedLinks=null;
  try{
    var window=this,document={
      createElement:function(){return{style:{},setAttribute:function(){},appendChild:function(){},innerHTML:'',textContent:''};},
      body:{appendChild:function(){}},getElementById:function(){return null;}
    };
    eval(code);
  }catch(e){/* DOM 部分可能抛错，encodedLinks 通常已赋值 */}
  if(!encodedLinks||!encodedLinks.length)return{err:'\u7ebf\u8def\u6570\u7ec4\u4e3a\u7a7a\u6216\u811a\u672c\u65e0\u6cd5\u6267\u884c'};
  var out=[],seen={};
  for(var i=0;i<encodedLinks.length;i++){
    var parts=String(encodedLinks[i]).split('|'),u='';
    try{u=OM_b64d(parts[0]).replace(/\/+$/,'');}catch(e2){}
    if(u.indexOf('http')!==0||seen[u])continue;
    seen[u]=1;
    out.push({u:u,n:parts[1]||u.replace(/^https?:\/\//,'')});
  }
  if(!out.length)return{err:'\u89e3\u7801\u540e\u65e0\u6709\u6548\u7ebf\u8def'};
  return{lines:out};
}

function OM_load(sv){
  var raw=OM_g(sv.get('om_lines'));
  if(raw){try{var a=JSON.parse(raw);if(a&&a.length)return a;}catch(e){}}
  var r=[];for(var i=0;i<OM_DEF.length;i++)r.push({u:OM_DEF[i],n:OM_DEF[i].replace(/^https?:\/\//,'')});
  return r;
}
function OM_save(sv,lines){
  var n=Math.min(lines.length,8);
  sv.put('om_lines',JSON.stringify(lines.slice(0,n)));
  sv.put('om_line',lines[0].u);
  for(var i=0;i<8;i++)sv.put('om_sp_'+i,'');
  return n;
}
function OM_status(sv){
  var arr=OM_load(sv),cur=OM_g(sv.get('om_line')).replace(/\/+$/,''),idx=-1;
  for(var i=0;i<arr.length;i++)if(arr[i].u===cur)idx=i;
  return '\u3010v7\u3011\u5f53\u524d\uff1a'+(cur||'\u9ed8\u8ba4')+(idx>=0?('\uff08\u7b2c'+(idx+1)+'\u6761\uff09'):'')
    +' \uff5c \u53d1\u5e03\u9875\uff1a'+OM_pub(sv)+' \uff5c \u5171 '+arr.length+' \u6761';
}
function OM_label(sv,i){
  var arr=OM_load(sv);
  if(i>=arr.length)return '\uff08\u7a7a\u4f4d '+(i+1)+'\uff09';
  var cur=OM_g(sv.get('om_line')).replace(/\/+$/,''),sp=OM_g(sv.get('om_sp_'+i));
  return (cur===arr[i].u?'\u2714 ':'')+'\u7ebf\u8def'+(i+1)+' '+arr[i].n+(sp?('  '+sp):'');
}
function OM_actGet(jv,sv){
  OM_toast(jv,'\u23f3 \u6b63\u5728\u8bfb\u53d6\u53d1\u5e03\u9875\uff0c\u8bf7\u7a0d\u5019\u2026');
  var res=OM_fetchLines(jv,OM_pub(sv));
  if(res.err){OM_toast(jv,'\u274c '+res.err+'\uff1b\u4e5f\u53ef\u5728\u4e0b\u65b9\u586b\u5199\u81ea\u5b9a\u4e49\u7ebf\u8def');return;}
  var n=OM_save(sv,res.lines);
  OM_toast(jv,'\u2705 \u5df2\u4ece\u53d1\u5e03\u9875\u83b7\u53d6 '+n+' \u6761\u7ebf\u8def\uff0c\u9ed8\u8ba4\u7b2c 1 \u6761\uff1b\u8bf7\u70b9\u300c\u6d4b\u8bd5\u5ef6\u65f6\u300d\u540e\u81ea\u884c\u70b9\u9009');
  try{jv.reLoginView();}catch(e){}
}
function OM_actSpeed(jv,sv){
  var arr=OM_load(sv);
  OM_toast(jv,'\u23f3 \u6b63\u5728\u6d4b\u901f '+arr.length+' \u6761\u7ebf\u8def\uff0c\u8bf7\u7a0d\u5019\u2026');
  var best=-1,bestMs=1e12;
  for(var i=0;i<arr.length;i++){
    var r=OM_GET(arr[i].u+'/');
    sv.put('om_sp_'+i,r.ok?(r.ms+'ms'):('\u4e0d\u53ef\u7528 '+r.ms+'ms'));
    if(r.ok&&r.ms<bestMs){bestMs=r.ms;best=i;}
  }
  if(best>=0){
    sv.put('om_sp_'+best,'\u26a1'+bestMs+'ms');
    OM_toast(jv,'\u2705 \u6d4b\u901f\u5b8c\u6210\uff0c\u6700\u5feb '+arr[best].n+' '+bestMs+'ms\uff1b\u70b9\u5bf9\u5e94\u300c\u7ebf\u8def N\u300d\u6309\u94ae\u5373\u53ef\u5207\u6362\uff08\u4e0d\u4f1a\u81ea\u52a8\u5207\uff09');
  }else{
    OM_toast(jv,'\u26a0 \u5168\u90e8\u7ebf\u8def\u63a2\u6d3b\u672a\u901a\u8fc7\uff0c\u8bf7\u68c0\u67e5\u7f51\u7edc\u6216\u91cd\u65b0\u83b7\u53d6\u53d1\u5e03\u9875\u7ebf\u8def');
  }
  try{jv.reLoginView();}catch(e){}
}
function OM_actSet(jv,sv,i){
  var arr=OM_load(sv);
  if(i>=arr.length){OM_toast(jv,'\u26a0 \u8be5\u7ebf\u8def\u4f4d\u4e3a\u7a7a\uff0c\u8bf7\u5148\u83b7\u53d6\u7ebf\u8def');return;}
  sv.put('om_line',arr[i].u);
  var r=OM_GET(arr[i].u+'/');
  OM_toast(jv,(r.ok?'\u2705 \u5df2\u5207\u6362 ':'\u26a0 \u5df2\u5207\u6362\u4f46\u63a2\u6d3b\u672a\u901a\u8fc7 ')+arr[i].n+'\uff08'+r.ms+'ms\uff09');
  try{jv.reLoginView();}catch(e){}
}
function OM_custom(jv,sv){
  var v=OM_g(sv.get('om_custom')).replace(/\/+$/,'');
  if(v.indexOf('https://')!==0){OM_toast(jv,'\u26a0 \u8bf7\u586b https:// \u5f00\u5934\u7684\u5b8c\u6574\u57df\u540d');return;}
  sv.put('om_line',v);
  OM_toast(jv,'\u2705 \u5df2\u5207\u6362\u81ea\u5b9a\u4e49\u7ebf\u8def\uff1a'+v);
  try{jv.reLoginView();}catch(e){}
}
function OM_reset(jv,sv){
  sv.put('om_lines','');sv.put('om_line',OM_DEF[0]);
  for(var i=0;i<8;i++)sv.put('om_sp_'+i,'');
  OM_toast(jv,'\u21a9 \u5df2\u6062\u590d\u9ed8\u8ba4 4 \u6761\u7ebf\u8def\uff1b\u82e5\u9700\u6700\u65b0\u7ebf\u8def\u8bf7\u70b9\u300c\u4e00\u952e\u4ece\u53d1\u5e03\u9875\u83b7\u53d6\u7f51\u5740\u8def\u7ebf\u300d');
  try{jv.reLoginView();}catch(e){}
}
function OM_actCheck(jv,sv){
  var arr=OM_load(sv),cur=OM_g(sv.get('om_line')).replace(/\/+$/,'');
  if(cur.indexOf('https://')!==0)cur=arr.length?arr[0].u:'';
  if(!cur){OM_toast(jv,'\u274c \u7ebf\u8def\u6c60\u4e3a\u7a7a\uff0c\u8bf7\u5148\u70b9\u300c\u4e00\u952e\u4ece\u53d1\u5e03\u9875\u83b7\u53d6\u7f51\u5740\u8def\u7ebf\u300d');return;}
  OM_toast(jv,'\u23f3 \u6b63\u5728\u81ea\u68c0 '+cur.replace(/^https?:\/\//,'')+' \u2026');
  var r=OM_GET(cur+'/');
  var shield=r.h.indexOf('\u7cfb\u7edf\u5b89\u5168\u9a8c\u8bc1')>=0||r.h.indexOf('verify_check')>=0;
  var n=0;try{var mm=r.h.match(/\/anime\/[a-f0-9]{24}\.html/g);n=mm?mm.length:0;}catch(e){}
  var state=shield?'\u26a0 \u5b89\u5168\u9a8c\u8bc1\u9875\uff08\u89c4\u5219\u4f1a\u81ea\u52a8\u8fc7\u76fe\uff09':(n>0?'\u2705 \u6b63\u5e38\u9875':'\u26a0 \u65e0\u5f71\u7247\u94fe\u63a5');
  var msg='v7 \u81ea\u68c0\uff5c'+cur.replace(/^https?:\/\//,'')+'\uff5c'+r.h.length+' \u5b57\u8282\uff5c'+state+'\uff5c\u5f71\u7247 '+n+' \u4e2a\uff5c'+r.ms+'ms';
  if(r.err)msg+='\uff5c\u9519\u8bef\uff1a'+String(r.err).substring(0,50);
  OM_toast(jv,msg);
  try{sv.put('om_lastcheck',msg);}catch(e2){}
  try{jv.reLoginView();}catch(e3){}
}
</js>
